{{Top|leg}}
An '''E-Bacta Shot''' was a type of experimental [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]]-based injection. They were very effective at healing, but when administered, they also dulled an individual's senses, and they never received approval to go on sale. During the [[Cularin Trade Show]], a trade show that was held in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] aboard the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[TAV Prosperity|TAV ''Prosperity'']], an E-Bacta Shot was available for puchase from a trade stand operated by the business [[Nenmo's Curios]].
